queries.exists: SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Antigravity IDE %' AND publisher = 'Google';
queries.patched: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM programs WHERE name LIKE 'Antigravity IDE %' AND publisher = 'Google' AND version_compare(version, '2.7.0') < 0);
queries.open: SELECT 1 WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM processes WHERE LOWER(name) = 'antigravity ide.exe');
